about_the_game:
Watch the feeds. Spot the intrusions. Hold the line.

Vast, unknowable entities have become irresistibly drawn to the noise and chaos of humanity—like a storm collapsing upon a flickering candle. Their efforts to enter our world have fractured reality, creating BREACHES—unnatural rifts where the fabric of existence wears thin.

Monitor surveillance feeds across key locations. Detect and report Breaches. Let too many Breaches slip by, and it's Game Over—not just for you, but for all of us.

BE EVER VIGILANT. GOOD LUCK.

FEATURES:

Surveillance Horror Gameplay
Spot subtle (and not-so-subtle) changes in up to 5 live camera feeds per level. Miss too many and face the consequences.

Sabotage and Disruption

The Breaches aren't the only threat. Stay sharp—unknown forces are actively working to sabotage your watch. Expect planted explosives, booby traps, and camera interference designed to shatter your focus. These hazards demand immediate attention—hesitation only results in failure

- 8 Atmospheric Levels at launch.

Each location offers a distinct flavor of dread, including:

  •  Carnival – Once joyous, now twisted and abandoned

  •  Outpost – Isolated. Storm-wracked. Not alone.

  •  Hospital – They don’t rest in peace

  •  Theatre – One final, haunting performance

  •  Safe House – It wasn’t safe enough

  •  Haunted Mansion – Echoes and shadows cling to the walls

  •  Empty House – A fire still burns. Dinner is served. No one's home

  •  Cyberlab – Experiments incomplete... but still alive

Over 600 Unique Breaches
Each level features 3–5 camera feeds, and every feed contains at least 20 handcrafted, reality-defying Breaches. That’s up to 100 unique events per level to learn, spot, and survive.

content_descriptors.notes: Contains depictions of implied suicide and murder

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-10700K CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2060
  • Storage: 17 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Low/Medium Graphic Settings
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10700K CPU
  • Memory: 16.0 GB GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2070 6GB or Equivalent
  • Storage: 17 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: High Graphic Settings

short_description: It’s your job to safeguard reality by watching the camera feeds and identifying changes in various key locations. But be careful, too many BREACHES seep in unnoticed and it will be GAME OVER for us all.
